facts.claim: This install runs Fallout4.exe 1.11.240.0 (Steam build 24564252).
Runtime lines: Old-Gen up to 1.10.163, Next-Gen 1.10.980-1.10.984, Anniversary Edition 1.11.x. Address Library bins exist for 1.10.130-1.10.163, 1.10.980-1.10.984 and 1.11.137-1.11.240.

facts.claim: F4SE ships f4se_loader.exe and f4se_<major>_<minor>_<build>.dll named after the runtime it supports; their version resource reads 0.A.B.C for F4SE A.B.C.
F4SE 0.7.9 is installed with f4se_1_11_240.dll matching the runtime; its source ships as src/f4se-0.7.9.tar.gz in the game folder.
The Address Library database is Data/F4SE/Plugins/version-<a>-<b>-<c>-<d>.bin, one file per runtime; the 1.11.240.0 file is present.

Creation Kit 1.11.246.0 installs into the game folder with Papyrus Compiler/PapyrusCompiler.exe 2.8.0.4, Tools/Archive2/Archive2.exe 1.1.0.5, Tools/LipGen/LipGenerator/LipGenerator.exe 1.0.0.1, Tools/Audio/xwmaencode.exe 9.28.1876.0, LIPFuzer and Elric. It is newer than the 1.11.240 runtime.
facts.source: version resources of the listed executables

facts.claim: Official Papyrus sources ship as Data/Scripts/Source/Base/Base.zip (2422 .psc are also loose in Base) and DLC01.zip-DLC06.zip in their DLC folders; the compiler flags file is Base/Institute_Papyrus_Flags.flg.
A BA2 header is 24 bytes: magic BTDX, u32 version, 4-char type GNRL or DX10, u32 file count, u64 name-table offset. Every installed archive parses with this layout.
facts.source: header census of every Data/*.ba2 on this install (0 errors)

Fallout4 - Misc.ba2 is v8 GNRL with 8570 files (base .pex), Fallout4 - Materials.ba2 v8 GNRL with 6899 files, Fallout4 - TexturesPatch.ba2 v8 DX10 with 7 files (smallest DX10 sample).

facts.claim: Vortex deploys into Data on this install (Data/vortex.deployment.json present) from a staging folder of 478 mod folders.
BA2 versions 7 and 8 use the version 1 record layout for both GNRL and DX10; all 643 installed archives parse and inflate a sampled entry with that layout (assumption A7 confirmed).

BA2 name and directory hashes are CRC-32 (reflected 0xEDB88320) with initial value 0 and no final XOR over the lowercase file stem and the lowercase backslash directory; 504352 of 504355 vanilla entries match (3 DLC entries carry names that differ from what was hashed).
facts.source: comparison over every Fallout4 - *.ba2 and DLC*.ba2 entry
facts.how: f4forge ba2 list <archive> (writer test: tests/test_f4forge.py Ba2Tests)

facts.claim: Vanilla GNRL archives never compress .pex, .fuz, .wav, .xwm, .strings/.dlstrings/.ilstrings, .swf, .gfx, .png, .xml or .dds; meshes, materials, text and havok files are mostly zlib-compressed. The forge writer stores the never-compressed list and compresses the rest when that shrinks the file.
facts.source: per-extension packed/stored counts over the vanilla archives

facts.claim: Every vanilla GNRL record carries flags 0x00100100 and alignment marker 0xBAADF00D.

DX10 chunk layout: a mip gets its own chunk while it has at least 512x512 pixels (262144), up to 3 single-mip chunks; the remaining mips share the last chunk (4 chunks at most); cubemaps are one chunk. Matches all 41077 vanilla DX10 entries and Archive2's own defaults (-maxChunkCount 4, -singleMipChunkX/Y 512). DX10 records: unknown byte 0, chunk header size 24, flags 0x800 (0x801 cubemap).

The forge writer repacked Fallout4 - Materials.ba2 (6899 files, GNRL v1) and Fallout4 - TexturesPatch.ba2 (7 files, DX10 v1): names, payload hashes and DX10 chunk layout equal the originals, texdiag accepts all 7 re-extracted DDS, and Archive2 1.1.0.5 extracts both forge-written archives with identical payload hashes. In-game load: NOT RUN.
facts.source: T12 round trip, report under the forge home reports/t12-ba2-roundtrip.json
facts.how: f4forge ba2 extract + f4forge ba2 pack + Archive2 -extract

facts.claim: Fallout 4 light plugins hold new object IDs up to 0xFFF. The floor is 0x001 when the plugin's HEDR version is at least 1.0 and it has at least one master (the 'hardcoded range' xEdit admits for FO4), otherwise 0x800. The same floor applies to new records in full plugins.
facts.source: xEdit dev-4.1.6 commit ee216dfac1e191a6ea821fbc3e492f8fb37b5a56, https://github.com/TES5Edit/TES5Edit/blob/ee216dfac1e191a6ea821fbc3e492f8fb37b5a56/Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas (gdHardcodedRangeAdmitted/MinVersion 1.0) and Core/wbImplementation.pas GetAllowHardcodedRangeUseByGeneration; MaxObjectID $FFF in Core/wbInterface.pas

facts.claim: All 188 installed .esl files pass the light-range check (182 HEDR 1.0 with IDs from 0x001, 6 HEDR 0.95 from 0x800).

The HEDR record count is not the number of records: Fallout4.esm declares 1741853 while a full walk finds 1549276 records in 112381 groups (56399 compressed). DLCCoast.esm declares 320320 and holds 309239 records in 11081 groups.
facts.source: plugin walk of the official masters

facts.claim: HEDR 1.0 plugins are what the Next-Gen and later runtimes and Creation Kit 1.11 produce; older runtimes expect 0.95.
facts.source: installed CC .esl files and Fallout4.esm carry 1.0 on the 1.11.240 runtime; older-runtime behaviour not tested
